name: Vault Steakhouse
summary: USDA prime dry-aged steaks and a bank-vault-themed dining room tucked into a quiet Apgujeong side street.
description: Vault Steakhouse is a Michelin Guide-listed American-style steakhouse near Apgujeong, built around a bank-vault motif and USDA prime, antibiotic-free beef aged in-house. The room is dim, formal and quiet rather than buzzy, which suits a relaxed family dinner more than a night-out crowd. Alongside dry-aged porterhouse and ribeye, the kitchen runs a raw bar with oysters and seafood towers. It works well for a celebration dinner for five who want a proper steakhouse experience without crossing the river to Cheongdam's loudest spots.
